transcript.en: Hello, South City International Club. How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 你好，南城国际俱乐部。请问您需要什么帮助？

transcript.en: Oh, good morning. I want to find out about joining the club.
transcript.zh: 早上好。我想了解加入俱乐部的情况。

transcript.en: Right. I can help you there. I’m the club secretary and my name’s Mary.
transcript.zh: 好的。我可以帮到您。我是俱乐部秘书，我叫玛丽。

transcript.en: Hi, Mary. My name’s Jim Hunter. Can you tell me about the events you have there?
transcript.zh: 嗨，玛丽。我叫吉姆·亨特。你能介绍一下你们的活动吗？

transcript.en: Sure. There are several events here, let me give you some details.
transcript.zh: 当然。有几个活动，我来给您说一下细节。

transcript.en: First of all, we have a library, you can use all the facilities there, and opening times are from 11 am to 6 pm.
transcript.zh: 首先，我们有一个图书馆，您可以使用那里的所有设施，开放时间是上午11点到下午6点。

transcript.en: Thank you.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。

transcript.en: Just to note, there’s a deposit of 15 dollars for using the library, which is returnable of course as long as there’s no damage.
transcript.zh: 需要注意的是，使用图书馆需要付15美元的押金，当然，只要没有损坏，可以退还。

transcript.en: That sounds fine. What else do you have?
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。你们还有什么？

transcript.en: Well, we also have an ice-skating center, which is next to a telephone booth.
transcript.zh: 我们还有一个滑冰中心，就在电话亭旁边。

transcript.en: The admission fee is 3 dollars. It’s only open on Sundays.
transcript.zh: 入场费为3美元。它只在周日开放。

transcript.en: Also, we have a special offer for new members - if you come to the center with a guest, then the guest can experience one class for free.
transcript.zh: 此外，我们还为新会员提供了特别优惠——如果您带一位客人一起来中心，那么客人可以免费体验一节课。

transcript.en: That is really a big attraction for me.
transcript.zh: 这对我来说有很大吸引力。

transcript.en: I remember walking past there yesterday, I saw a poster about swimming.
transcript.zh: 记得我昨天路过了那儿，看到一张游泳海报。

transcript.en: Do you have any swimming classes?
transcript.zh: 有游泳课吗？

transcript.en: Yes, that is a new class. It starts on the 16th of October.
transcript.zh: 有，那是一个新课程。从10月16日开始。

transcript.en: Right. Is it very expensive?
transcript.zh: 对。贵吗？

transcript.en: Well, the joining fee is only 1 dollar - oh no, I’m sorry, it’s recently gone up by 2 dollars, so it’s now 3 dollars for each person.
transcript.zh: 加入的费用只要1美元——哦，不，对不起，最近涨了2美元，所以现在是3美元一个人。

transcript.en: And we don’t provide any swimming suits here so you need to bring your own.
transcript.zh: 而且我们这儿不提供泳衣，所以您需要自备。

transcript.en: I see. What about dance lessons? You mentioned that you have classes once a week.
transcript.zh: 好的。舞蹈课呢？你提到你们每周有一次课。

transcript.en: Yes, the dance classes are very popular here.
transcript.zh: 是的，这里的舞蹈课很受欢迎。

transcript.en: It’s a little expensive, the joining fee is 5 dollars, but that includes free drinks.
transcript.zh: 有点贵，加入费用是5美元，但是里面包括免费的酒水。

transcript.en: We open all day, and you can bring your own water and food.
transcript.zh: 我们全天营业，您可以自带水和食物。

transcript.en: Well, it’s still more expensive than I thought.
transcript.zh: 嗯，还是比我想象的贵。

transcript.en: I’m a student here and I’m only here for six months.
transcript.zh: 我是这里的学生，我只在这儿呆六个月。

transcript.en: Ah, then we offer you a great way to learn about Britain.
transcript.zh: 那我们可以为您提供一个了解英国的好方法。

transcript.en: We usually visit the Grand Hotel, a historical site, but this time we are going to the local museum.
transcript.zh: 我们通常是去大饭店、历史遗迹，这次是去本地博物馆。

transcript.en: The joining fee is 3 dollars. It is open between 10.30 am and 3.30 pm during weekdays, and on weekends, it’s half an hour earlier.
transcript.zh: 加入费为3美元。平日上午10.30至下午3.30开放，周末提前半小时开放。

transcript.en: That should be all right. I could come in my free periods.
transcript.zh: 应该没问题。我可以在空闲时间来。

transcript.en: By the way, I’m quite interested in tennis. I enjoy playing with my friends after work. Do you have tennis events I could join?
transcript.zh: 顺便说一句，我对网球很感兴趣。我喜欢学习结束后和朋友一起打网球。你们有我可以参加的网球赛事吗？

transcript.en: No, I’m afraid we don’t. Perhaps you are thinking about North City Center.
transcript.zh: 恐怕我们没有。也许你可以看看北城中心。

transcript.en: They’ve got a lot of events we don’t have, and vice versa. But we organize events such as movie watching as long as there are over 30 viewers and we have a lecture every four weeks.
transcript.zh: 他们有很多我们没有的活动，反之亦然。但是我们会组织看电影等活动，只要有超过 30 名观众，另外，我们每四周有一次讲座。

transcript.en: Do you have any yoga classes?
transcript.zh: 你有瑜伽课吗？

transcript.en: Yes, we do have some yoga lessons, but the timetable is still in discussion.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们确实有一些瑜伽课，但时间表仍在讨论中。

transcript.en: However, we arrange a Saturday excursion every month. You can come and check it out.
transcript.zh: 但是，我们每个月都会安排一次周六游览。您可以过来看看。

transcript.en: Great. I heard there would be other outdoor activities, like a tour or something.
transcript.zh: 太好了。听说会有其他的户外活动，比如旅游什么的。

transcript.en: Yes, that’s right, we will offer a night city tour if you are interested. And as well as that there’s a cultural evening event once a month.
transcript.zh: 是的，没错，如果您有兴趣，我们将提供夜间城市之旅。除此之外，还有每月一次的文化晚会。

transcript.en: That sounds good. But it is a pity that there’s no tennis at your club.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。但是很遗憾你们俱乐部没有网球。

transcript.en: Mm, I will pass on your feedback to management. So if you would like to join in the club, you need to fill out a form and pay 108 dollars if you’re over 19, and 95 dollars if you’re under.
transcript.zh: 我会把您的反馈转达给管理层。如果您想加入俱乐部，需要填写一张表格，19岁以上需支付108美元，19岁以下95美元。

transcript.en: Both will need to be submitted to the club office. They will help you apply for the membership card.
transcript.zh: 表格和费用都需要提交给俱乐部办公室。他们会帮您申请会员卡。

transcript.en: Okay, thanks for that information. I think I have all I need for now.
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢提供这些信息。我已经都了解清楚了。

transcript.en: Thank you for calling South City International Club. Bye.
transcript.zh: 感谢您致电南城国际俱乐部。再见。
